w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: They argued over names for 6 beasts — 6 words, 6 debates: "Ugly-Eyes" (2), "The Big Bastard" (2), "The Big Bastard" (2), "Loud-Eyes" (2), "Big Loud" (2), "Old Gavel" (2).

loss.line: Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.
